equity.equity_measurement: Disparities are assessed only by World Bank country income group (not an SPD) and WHO region; an 'equity gap' is named for low-income, conflict-affected countries.

notes: No tests, models or CIs; percent changes are arithmetic and coverage estimates come from WUENIC. Comparisons span 2012/2019/2022, six WHO regions and four country income groups; the headline 2012 vs 2022 contrast leads as a pair.
view_issues: Summary says incidence declined 81% from 2013 to 2021, but the abstract and table give 2012 to 2022. Table lists EUR 2019 verified as 45 (91), but 45/53 is 85%. Text cites 26 low-income countries in 2022 while Figure 2 note says 13.
